title: Kissed Spicy Argentinian Beef Empanadas
description: A sweet and spicy Argentinian dish featuring beef and cheese, perfect for a meal prep lunch or snack, with a Mediterranean twist using pepper and bain-marie cooking method.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they are softened.
Stir in the spicy pepper sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture onto the center of each dough circle, followed by a sprinkle of shredded cheese.
Fold the dough in half over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve the empanadas hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
